title: Ambient and supplied-model Padic cohomology flatness
statement: Let T be noetherian, of bounded Krull dimension, with l invertible in every stalk, E/Q_l finite, and K a bounded constructible complete complex over the unlifted Padic datum [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-complete]. Every ambient H^q(K) is flat if and only if for every simultaneous choice of integral bounds, finite stratification, covering sieves and a supplied common local model on every covering arrow [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower], every cohomology sheaf of each supplied model is flat over the actual inverse-image completed coefficient ring [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules].

proof.text: Flatness of a sheaf of modules is invariant under isomorphism, since tensoring on the right with isomorphic objects gives isomorphic functors. Algebraic inverse image preserves flatness. Compare the algebraic inverse image supplied by the pro-etale site with the actual ring-module pullback over the unchanged inverse-image coefficient ring, using the scalar-extension comparison for an identity coefficient isomorphism. The proved private universe adapter in the ringed K-flat pullback module converts its algebraic inverse-image data to the independent-universe interface; the K-flat preservation theorem itself is not applied.

source.place: Proof steps 2 and 9--11; reconstruction by isomorphism of the two Roos sequences, and descent by tensor kernels.

proof.text: Flatness descends along the fixed covers of a finite stratification. For a monomorphism, form the kernel of its tensor with the proposed flat module. Exact inverse image and the ordinary tensor comparison identify its restrictions with zero kernels. Forgetting module structure and the underlying additive inverse-image comparison reduce vanishing to Noetherian stratum detection. Thus the tensor map has zero kernel and is monic. Tensor preserves finite colimits, so preservation of these monomorphisms gives exactness and hence flatness.

source.place: Proof steps 2 and 9--11; reconstruction by isomorphism of the two Roos sequences, and descent by tensor kernels.

proof.text: For every supplied common local model, the reconstruction theorem identifies its derived object with the exact derived inverse image of K. The homology comparison for an exact functor then identifies each cohomology sheaf with inverse image of the ambient cohomology sheaf. The first step transports ambient flatness to every supplied model.

source.place: Proof steps 2 and 9--11; reconstruction by isomorphism of the two Roos sequences, and descent by tensor kernels.

proof.text: For the converse, choose the uniform local models included in the constructible-complete hypothesis. Their cohomology comparison identifies the restricted ambient cohomology with the supplied-model cohomology. Convert the covering sieves to covers. The hypothesis gives flatness on each such cover, and the descent argument gives flatness of every ambient cohomology sheaf. This works also for empty strata and zero models.

theorem pbc_adic_flat_iff_supplied_model_flat
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T]
    (_hdim : ∃ n : ℕ, topologicalKrullDim T ≤ n)
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type (u + 1)) [Field E]
    [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (_hl : ∀ t : T, IsUnit (l : T.presheaf.stalk t))
    (K : PbcBoundedConstructibleComplete T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)) :
    (∀ q : ℤ, SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := ProEt.topology T)
        (R := pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E))
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj K.obj)) ↔
    ∀ (d₀ d₁ : ℤ), d₀ ≤ d₁ → ∀ (S : Stratification T)
        (V : ∀ α : Fin S.n, Sieve (⊤_ (S.domain α).ProEt)),
        (∀ α : Fin S.n, V α ∈ ProEt.topology (S.domain α) (⊤_ (S.domain α).ProEt)) →
        ∀ L : ∀ (α : Fin S.n) (U : (S.domain α).ProEt)
            (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ (S.domain α).ProEt),
            V α f → AdicTowerLocalModel (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E) (U.hom ≫ S.immersion α)
              (pbcReductionAdicTower T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E) K.obj) d₀ d₁,
          ∀ (α : Fin S.n) (U : (S.domain α).ProEt)
            (f : U ⟶ ⊤_ (S.domain α).ProEt) (hf : V α f) (q : ℤ),
            SheafOfModules.IsFlatOnSite (J := ProEt.topology U.left)
              (R := (adicTowerInverseImage (U.hom ≫ S.immersion α)).obj
                (pbcAdicCompletion T (pbcPadicCoefficientDatum l E)))
              ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).obj
                (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (L α U f hf).complex))
